posts.name: MysticCow
posts.cooked:
The haste makes up for the smaller seal damage, because you’re getting more SoR hits from the hasted weapon that procs like it’s 2.0 instead of 1.0. And it’s for 90 seconds if you use all charges.

You don’t use Command (save for Judgement time) with a MCP. You use the guaranteed proc of Righteousness with a wacky proc weapon like MCP or Flurry Axe.

MCP makes up for the other problems this way.

posts.name: Smeet
posts.cooked:
Thingummywut:

doesn’t seal of command benefit from slower weapons better? Or does the increased attack speed-crits make up for it? Ret does gain additional damage on crit, but wouldn’t you just hit the ppm on it too fast?

SoC is definitely stronger on slower weapons, but the 50% attack speed boost causes you to get more SoC hits as well. (There is no limit to how many SoC hits you can get in a minute, the PPM just sets the chance to proc on MCP at around 23% per hit)

Because of that, it very quickly outpaces every other 2h in average damage per second as your stats improve.

By best in slot gear and full world buffs it deals more DPS than Might of Menethil on average for the 90 seconds it is active.

posts.name: Smeet
posts.cooked:
Redfall:

MCP is subpar for ret paladins. Feel free to research WCL and wonder why none of the best rets in the world are using it

Because hand of rag getting lucky and Criting 60+% of the time on a 10 swing fight is a higher spike than MCP, which has the higher average.

Top logs are usually just examples of good luck more than anything else (especially on rets, since their special attacks are also RNG based).

MCP = highest average
Ashkandi / Hand of Rag = potential for higher individual parses if the fights are short.

The “top rets” are typically more concerned with hitting that #1 parse than using the setup that works best on average (plus pretty much all of us loathe the idea of farming the thing)

Beautia:

You don’t use Command (save for Judgement time) with a MCP.

If you are running a more standard gearing with MCP (not stacking SP), SoC is much stronger than SoR, even on MCP.

Thingummywut:

doesn’t most of ret damage comes from seal of command amplified by seal of crusader.

No, most ret DPS comes from auto attacks. Seal of Command is the second largest source of damage, and on average an MCP will get 10.5 procs per minute due to the haste, which offsets the lower damage hits.

Judgment of the Crusader is a fairly minor dps buff unless you are running spelladin.

Caliban:

I just want to see how fast it swings with seal of crusader up

MCP + SotC swings once every .95 seconds, although it is a very weak seal.
